claims.text:
stage computation: Declared factorized toy: factual lookup[A:2,B:3] is frozen; formatting JSON probability=sigmoid(theta), theta0=0. JSON-labelled formatting example has Bernoulli negative-log-loss gradient p−1. Eta2 update gives theta1=1, P(JSON)=.7310586; second update theta=1.5378828, P(JSON)≈.823156. Factual answer A stays2 in either format.

**Countercase / boundary:** Change formatting labels to plain text0, restart theta0 and update: theta=−1, P(JSON)=.2689414, still factual A2. An external supplied “A now4” test does not change this frozen channel; factual correctness on that update remains false. This architecture deliberately prevents factual learning, so it does not prove real fine-tuning cannot teach facts.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether training formatting changes the fixed A fact; recall a new B formatting instruction can alter format probability while lookupB stays3.

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Train format step computes logit/probability and renders two possible format templates with same factual value; Counter-label and Test new fact show the separate channels. Do not sample formatting and confuse one random output with learned probability.
